meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 安装后，模型能调用语言服务器工具，检查代码诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、查看符号，并安全执行重命名。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用、符号或重命名安全检查时触发；缺少语言服务器时可用状态工具排查。

say.text: 检查这个文件的代码诊断，只看错误。
say.note: 会调用诊断工具并过滤错误级别。

say.text: 跳转到这个符号的定义。
say.note: 使用当前光标位置查找定义。

say.text: 安全地重命名这个变量。
say.note: 先检查重命名有效性，再应用。

howto.what_en: This skill lets the model call language-server tools to check diagnostics, go to definitions, find references, inspect symbols, and safely rename code.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you need LSP diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace; the status tool helps when a language server is missing.

say_en.text: Check diagnostics for this file, only errors.
say_en.note: Calls the diagnostics tool and filters by severity.

say_en.text: Go to the definition of this symbol.
